releaseNotes:
What changed:
- New Anime section, on the home row and in the phone footer. Browse by trending,
  top airing, popular, top rated, latest or newest, filter to TV, movies, ONA, OVA
  or specials, and search the catalogue.
- Every anime has a landing page with its facts, synopsis and full episode list,
  with filler episodes marked.
- Pick dub or sub per title; your choice is remembered for the next one.
- Anime episodes join watch history and the continue watching row like anything else.

Already on 1.53.0 or newer? This installs itself as usual.

On 1.52.1 or older? 1.53.0 changed the app's identity, so Android will not install this
over your copy and the in-app update stops with "The downloaded update belongs to a
different app." Uninstall GIZTV once, then install this build from the release page.
Watch history does not carry across that one reinstall. Updates after it are automatic.
